evidence.note: signature_placement check failed. The Response signature itself verified against the configured IdP certificate.

output.fix: Keep the SP requirement for a signed Assertion. In the Entra enterprise application, open Single sign-on, then SAML Certificates, then Edit. Set Signing Option to "Sign SAML response and assertion". Entra's default is to sign only the response. Save, then capture a new response and re-validate. The other checks (status, issuer, destination, InResponseTo, audience, recipient, time window, NameID, attributes, certificate) all passed. Don't relax the SP to accept a response-only signature, because that would weaken assertion integrity.

alternatives.why_not: signature_verify passed against idp_cert_pem. The problem is which element is signed, not whether the signature is valid.
